text: APPROVE. The loop moves unchanged into `ReadFromVersions` and the `num` check into `HasNum`, so behaviour is identical (non-object skip, exact ordinal match when a version is requested, first object otherwise, null at the end). Parse loses the foreach and its nested ifs, so it should fall well under 15, and the new code has no obvious nullability or analyzer problems. I haven't built it or checked for name collisions with `ReadFromVersions` or `HasNum` elsewhere in the file.
